items.title: Qatar’s Tourism Recovery is Coming by Road, Not Air
items.summary: Qatar’s visitor numbers are recovering on road traffic across the Saudi border, while air arrivals keep falling. Drive-in visitors tend to make shorter trips, which limits how much they can do for hotels.

items.title: Airbnb CEO: Our Specialized AI Agents Will Handle ‘Every Vertical in Travel’
items.summary: There's been speculation for years about whether Airbnb would launch flights. Such small-minded speculation: Airbnb intends to use specialized AI agents to do every travel vertical. Airbnb Cruise, anyone?

items.title: Airbnb Outpaces Rivals With Its Fastest Revenue Growth in 3 Years

items.title: Airbnb-Backed Candidates Lose in LA, a Setback in Push to Loosen Rental Rules

items.title: Tripadvisor Cuts Jobs, Outgoing CEO Says Experiences Overhaul Fell Short
items.summary: The Tripadvisor-Viator experiences business has long had a "Tripadvisor" brand problem. The consolidation of their teams didn't work, and both experiences revenue and profits fell in the third quarter.

items.title: EU’s Sustainable Tourism Plan Aims to Spread Visitors Out — With No Funding or Targets
items.summary: The EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy sits on top of existing tourism strategies released by the economic bloc’s Commission. But it still falls short of presenting measurable targets that would actually support its implementation.
